props.label: Who is the best painter in Ku-ring-gai?
props.html:
Who is the best painter in Ku-ring-gai?

Sydney Paintmasters is a licensed and insured painting team with over 20 years of experience across the Ku-ring-gai LGA, from Roseville up to Wahroonga. We paint homes, heritage and Federation properties, strata blocks and commercial sites, and we quote at a fixed price with no call-out fee. Phone 0423 019 087 for a free on-site quote.

What areas?
All 17 Ku-ring-gai suburbs, including St Ives, Pymble, Turramurra, Gordon, Killara, Lindfield and Warrawee.
What does it cost?
Every job is a fixed-price quote after an on-site look. No call-out fee, and the price you accept is the price you pay.
Licensed and insured?
Yes. Fully licensed and insured. Licence details on request, so the work is covered start to finish.
How fast?
We reply to quote requests within 2 business hours during our 6AM to 6PM window, Monday to Saturday.

props.label: Services
props.html:
What we paint

Painting services across Ku-ring-gai

One team for the whole job. Prep, protection, paint and a tidy finish, on time and to a written quote. Here is what we take on.

House Painting in Ku-ring-gai

Full repaints for homes across the Upper North Shore, inside and out. Careful prep, clean lines, colours that suit the street.

Interior Painting

Walls, ceilings, cornices, doors and trims. We mask, cover and protect, then leave the place cleaner than we found it.

Exterior Painting

Weatherboard, render, brick and fibre cement. Coatings built for shade, damp and hard Sydney sun on open elevations.

Office Painting

Fit-outs and refreshes for local offices. We work around your hours, including early starts, so trade never stops.

Strata Painting

Common property, unit blocks and townhouse complexes. Clear scope, staged access and reporting your committee can follow.

Commercial Painting

Shopfronts, warehouses and fit-outs. Durable finishes, safe access, and scheduling that keeps your doors open.

Epoxy Flooring

Garage, laundry and workshop floors in a tough, wipe-clean epoxy. Sealed, level and ready for daily wear.

Pool Painting

Concrete pool coatings that hold up to water, chemicals and sun. Proper prep so the finish stays put.

Roof Painting

Clean, prime and recoat tired tile and metal roofs. Fresh colour, sealed surface, better street appeal.

props.label: Areas
props.html:
Where we work

Local painters, suburb by suburb

Ku-ring-gai is not one street of houses. It runs from Federation heritage streets to bushland-edge modern homes, and each pocket paints a little differently. Two areas have their own detailed pages; the rest are covered here.

Featured area page

Painter St Ives

Large modern and mid-century homes, bushland exposure and the St Ives Shopping Village precinct. Full detail on its own page.

See the St Ives page →
Featured zone page

Painter Lindfield, Killara & Gordon

The Federation heritage belt on the North Shore line, with dense conservation areas and period colour work. Covered on its own page.

See the Federation belt page →

Painters in Roseville and Roseville Chase

Roseville 2069 · Roseville Chase 2069

Roseville's older streets sit inside heritage conservation areas, so the Federation and Californian bungalow homes here want careful timber prep and period-friendly colour schemes, not just a quick coat. The art-deco cinema strip gives the shops their own character. Down towards Middle Harbour, the post-war waterfront homes of Roseville Chase take a harder weather hit, so we lean on tougher, moisture-ready exterior systems there.

Painters in Pymble and West Pymble

Pymble 2073 · West Pymble 2073

Pymble holds some of the biggest heritage estate homes in the district, across the widest run of period styles: Federation, Spanish Mission, Georgian sandstone, even a landmark Walter Burley Griffin house. Large blocks, detailed timberwork and colour schemes worth getting right. West Pymble, out near Bicentennial Park, is mostly newer post-war homes and paints as a straightforward modern repaint.

Painters in Wahroonga and North Wahroonga

Wahroonga 2076 · North Wahroonga 2076

Wahroonga mixes Federation bungalows and Arts and Crafts homes with the odd mid-century landmark, including the State-heritage-listed Rose Seidler House nearby. Mature gardens mean shade and leaf litter on the walls, so exteriors need a proper wash and mould treatment before a brush goes near them. North Wahroonga adds a quieter, leafier bushland edge with the same care needed on timber and eaves.

Painters in Turramurra, North Turramurra and South Turramurra

Turramurra · North & South Turramurra 2074

Turramurra is a family suburb of Federation and California bungalow homes clustered around the Turramurra Plaza shops. North and South Turramurra sit on the bushland and golf-course fringe and are largely 1960s houses, so you get a real spread of eras. We handle both: heritage-careful work on the older homes, clean modern finishes on the newer ones.

Painters in Warrawee

Warrawee 2074

Warrawee is about as exclusive as the Upper North Shore gets. Large architect-designed estates on deep blocks, heritage conservation across much of the suburb, and no shopping strip at all. The work here is premium and discreet: restoration painting, detailed timber and render, and colour advice that respects the age of the home.

Painters in St Ives Chase

St Ives Chase 2075

St Ives Chase runs north of St Ives into the bushland fringe. The homes are mostly post-1960s and contemporary, weather-exposed and close to bush, so this is durable-coating territory rather than heritage compliance. Want the full St Ives write-up? It lives on the St Ives painter page.

Painters in East Killara and East Lindfield

East Killara 2071 · East Lindfield 2070

These are the modern eastern flanks of the Killara and Lindfield heritage belt, mostly sitting outside the conservation areas. Think post-war double-brick and mid-century homes that paint cleanly and simply. The heritage core is covered on the Lindfield, Killara and Gordon page.

props.label: Process
props.html:
Simple from the start

Three steps to a fresh coat

No wizards, no runaround. Here is the whole thing.

1

Free on-site quote

We come out, look at the actual job, and give you a fixed written price. No call-out fee, no guessing over the phone.

2

Prep and protect

The part that lasts. We wash, sand, fill, treat mould, mask and cover, then prime what needs it before any topcoat.

3

Paint and walk-through

We paint, clean up, and walk the job with you. You sign off when it’s right. That is the point of the fixed price.

props.label: Specialties
props.html:
Where we go deeper

Built for Ku-ring-gai homes

Three things the Upper North Shore throws at a painter that a generic crew tends to miss.

Heritage

Heritage and Federation homes

Federation, Inter-War and character homes across Wahroonga, Turramurra, Pymble, Killara, Gordon and Lindfield need patient prep, timber restoration and period-appropriate colours. We work to the age of the home, not against it.

Premium

Large Upper North Shore homes

Multi-storey residences, detailed timberwork, rendered facades, feature entrances and long verandahs. Big exterior surfaces done properly, with access and protection planned before we start.

Bushland

Bushland and tree-canopy exteriors

Homes under dense canopy sit in shade and damp, collect leaf debris and grow mould. We use durable coating systems suited to shaded walls, moisture and strong seasonal UV on the open elevations.

props.label: Faq General
props.html:
Booking and quotes

Common questions before you book

The practical stuff: quotes, timing, cover and payment.

How do I book a painter in Ku-ring-gai?
Call 0423 019 087 or send the quote form on this page. We arrange a time to look at the job on site, usually within a few days, then give you a fixed written quote. Say yes and we lock in a start date that suits you.
Is the quote really free, with no call-out fee?
Yes. The on-site quote is free and there is no call-out fee. We look at the work, measure up, talk through colours and give you one fixed price. There is no charge for the visit whether you go ahead or not.
How is a painting job priced?
On a fixed-price basis after we see it in person. Surface condition, prep needed, height and access, and the number of coats all affect the figure. Once you accept the written quote, that is the price. No hourly surprises at the end.
Are you licensed and insured?
Yes, fully licensed and insured. Our licence details are available on request (Licence 315254C), and we carry current public liability cover, so your property and our team are protected for the duration of the job.
Which paint brands do you use?
We use trade-grade products from the major Australian brands such as Dulux and Taubmans, matched to the surface and the exposure. If you have a preferred brand or a heritage colour range in mind, tell us and we’ll work with it.
How do you take payment?
Payment terms are set out on your written quote before any work starts, so there are no surprises. We accept standard methods including bank transfer. Ask us at quote stage and we’ll confirm what suits the job.
How long will my job take?
A single interior room is often a day. A full house exterior on the Upper North Shore usually runs several days to a week or more, depending on size, prep and weather. Your quote includes an honest time estimate, and we tell you early if rain moves an exterior day.

props.label: Faq Local
props.html:
Local questions

Painting in Ku-ring-gai, answered

The questions we get most from Upper North Shore homeowners.

Do you paint heritage and Federation homes in Ku-ring-gai?
Yes, it’s one of our main jobs here. Much of Ku-ring-gai sits in heritage conservation areas, so we prep timber carefully, repair before we paint, and use period-appropriate colours. If your street has colour guidance, we work within it.
What suburbs in Ku-ring-gai do you cover?
All 17: East Killara, East Lindfield, Gordon, Killara, Lindfield, North Turramurra, North Wahroonga, Pymble, Roseville, Roseville Chase, South Turramurra, St Ives, St Ives Chase, Turramurra, Wahroonga, Warrawee and West Pymble. St Ives and the Lindfield, Killara and Gordon belt also have their own detailed pages.
My home is under heavy tree cover. Does that change the paint job?
It does. Canopy shade keeps walls damp, drops leaf litter and encourages mould, especially on southern and shaded elevations. We wash down, treat mould at the source, and use durable, moisture-ready exterior coatings so the finish lasts in bush-edge conditions.
Do you do strata and unit-block painting in Ku-ring-gai?
Yes. We handle common property and unit blocks across suburbs like Gordon, Lindfield and Killara, with a clear scope, staged access to keep residents moving, and reporting your strata committee or manager can actually follow.
Can you help me pick exterior colours that suit a heritage street?
Absolutely. We’ll walk the palette with you at quote stage, factoring in the era of the home, the streetscape and any conservation-area guidance. Heritage colour ranges from the major brands give plenty of authentic options.
When is the best time to paint an exterior on the Upper North Shore?
Cooler, drier stretches from autumn through spring are ideal, but we paint year round and simply plan around the weather. We won’t topcoat in rain or heavy damp, and we’ll tell you early if an exterior day needs to shift.
How quickly can you get to my job?
We reply to quote requests within 2 business hours during our 6AM to 6PM window, Monday to Saturday. Start dates depend on the season and the size of the job, and we’ll give you a realistic date with your written quote.

/* clone-only: behaviour helpers, no visual or content change */
.mobile-submenu{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0 0 6px;background:#f6f8fc}
.mobile-submenu a{padding-left:40px;font-size:.94rem;font-weight:600}
.mobile-submenu[hidden]{display:none}
header .nav>ul>li:hover>ul{opacity:1!important;visibility:visible!important;transform:translateY(0)!important}

/* clone-only: quote popup */
.spm-modal{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9999;display:none}
.spm-modal.open{display:block}
.spm-modal__backdrop{position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgba(28,41,63,.62);backdrop-filter:blur(3px);opacity:0;transition:opacity .22s ease}
.spm-modal.open .spm-modal__backdrop{opacity:1}
.spm-modal__scroll{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow-y:auto;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center;padding:24px 16px 40px}
.spm-modal__dialog{position:relative;width:100%;max-width:520px;margin:auto;transform:translateY(16px) scale(.98);opacity:0;transition:transform .24s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.3,1),opacity .24s ease}
.spm-modal.open .spm-modal__dialog{transform:none;opacity:1}
.spm-modal__dialog>div{max-width:none!important;width:100%}
.spm-modal__dialog h2,.spm-modal__dialog h3{padding-right:46px}
.spm-modal__close{position:absolute;top:18px;right:18px;z-index:3;width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;border:none;background:var(--light,#f0f0fa);color:var(--navy,#1c293f);font-size:.95rem;line-height:1;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;transition:background .18s ease,color .18s ease,transform .18s ease}
.spm-modal__close:hover{background:var(--primary,#016edc);color:#fff;transform:rotate(90deg)}
.spm-modal__close:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#ffa800);outline-offset:2px}
@media(max-width:520px){.spm-modal__close{top:14px;right:14px;width:32px;height:32px}.spm-modal__dialog h2,.spm-modal__dialog h3{padding-right:40px}}
body.spm-modal-open{overflow:hidden}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.spm-modal__backdrop,.spm-modal__dialog{transition:none}}
